name: visual-tool
description: Browser test of global motion and global form (Glass pattern) coherence thresholds.

scripts.test:e2e: VITE_API_URL= npm run build && node tests/e2e/layout.cjs && node tests/e2e/blindspot.cjs && node tests/e2e/full.cjs && node tests/e2e/contribute.cjs
scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:backend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.backend:up: scripts/remote.sh docker compose up -d --build firestore backend backend-e2e
scripts.backend:debug: scripts/remote.sh docker compose -f compose.yaml -f compose.debug.yaml up -d --build firestore backend
